title: Character description (character.json)
description: Selects the fixed GH3 rig profile of the character GLB. The profile also selects the band role.

hairMaterials.description: GLB material names whose triangles use sorted hair transparency.

attachments.description: Attachment slot to a library instrument ID (band/band.json member instrument). An absent slot uses the default. The instrument follows the band role that the character plays.
